Bell attended [[Long Beach Polytechnic High School]] in [[Long Beach, California]].[http://www.sbsun.com/sports/20170331/jordan-bell-has-traveled-a-long-way-from-long-beach-to-final-four-with-oregon Jordan Bell has traveled a long way from Long Beach to Final Four with Oregon] He committed to the [[University of Oregon]] to play [[college basketball]].[http://www.gazettes.com/sports/poly/basketball-poly-s-jordan-bell-commits-to-oregon/article_769116c0-2ddd-11e2-8f88-001a4bcf887a.html Basketball: Poly's Jordan Bell Commits To Oregon] As a freshman at Oregon, Bell averaged 5.1 points, 6.1 rebounds and 2.7 blocks per game.[http://www.oregonlive.com/ducks/index.ssf/2015/12/jordan_bell_could_make_debut_s.html Jordan Bell could make debut Saturday when No. 24 Oregon Ducks face Boise State] His 94 blocks were a school record for a season.[http://www.dailynews.com/sports/20160325/whicker-jordan-bell-brings-block-party-to-oregon-ducks Whicker: Jordan Bell brings block party to Oregon Ducks] As a sophomore, he averaged 7.0 points, 5.4 rebounds and 1.8 blocks per game.[http://www.oregonlive.com/ducks/index.ssf/2016/10/jordan_bell_expected_to_play_s.html Jordan Bell expected to play smaller for Ducks: Oregon rundown] As a junior, Bell averaged 10.9 points, 8.8 rebounds and 2.3 blocks per game and helped lead Oregon to the [[Final Four]].[http://www.oregonlive.com/ducks/index.ssf/2017/03/jordan_bells_work_in_the_summe.html Jordan Bell's summer work has paid off during Oregon Ducks' Final Four run][http://www.latimes.com/sports/more/la-sp-oregon-bell-20170331-story.html Given direction, Oregon's Jordan Bell finds way to the Final Four] On 18th April 2017,
